name: get_host_shell
description: Return the host shell executable, default working directory, and capability status.

name: run_host_shell
description: Run a command in a fresh noninteractive /bin/sh on the shared host, with no live stdin. Return its outcome, stdout/stderr descriptions, full log paths, and any stdout image. Remaining processes in its group are stopped when the invocation ends.

cwd.description: Working directory, absolute or relative to Ivenna's startup directory (the default).

timeout_ms.description: Command timeout in milliseconds. Omit for 600000 (10 minutes).

interpretation.description: Present complete nonempty stdout text as an image URL. Omit for automatic byte detection.
